<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap pages against the core problem of reconciling claim reserves between the platform and internal spreadsheets.
